feeds.title: Puzzle Wanderer Blog
feeds.description: My name's Greg, born in 1999 and raised in Israel. As of writing this (later 2021), I'm a Master's student in business & management. But I started my studies at the university at 13 years old. Around that time, I discovered the hobby of puzzles. It all started with a good old Rubik's Cube. I got enthusiastic pretty fast and rushed head-on into the works of the best puzzle designers. I've solved hundreds of puzzles since then, which isn't that much compared to other serious collectors. But I'm having fun at my own pace.

feeds.title: Puzzling In Wonderlands
feeds.description: This blog intends to share my puzzling hobby with you guys. I don't own all the puzzles I will review them here. I have some of them, I played or borrowed others from friends or at some puzzle parties. I will review some different kinds of puzzles like metal puzzles, wooden puzzles, and maze puzzles...from unknown designers to very known ones.

feeds.title: Puzzling Times
feeds.description: Puzzling Times blog is about the occasional ramblings of a bloke who enjoys being puzzled. You will find intriguing puzzles, how to solve them and experience that the author had while solving them.

feeds.title: Kubiya Games Blog
feeds.description: Kubiya Games is a Brooklyn-based company specializing in handmade wooden mechanical puzzles, escape room puzzles, brain teaser puzzles, and brain games. We search for games and puzzles that have been forgotten over time and bring them back to life with historical accuracy or modern design changes. The majority of puzzles and games in our collection were created before the 19th century.

feeds.title: Mr Puzzle Australia Blog
feeds.description: At Mr Puzzle we know puzzles! We sell ONLY puzzles. We've been making and selling complex puzzles and brainteasers since 1992 and had an online store since 1998. ur specialty is very hard puzzles and other specialty puzzles sourced from around the world; many of the puzzles we sell are not available anywhere else.

feeds.title: The Intrism Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, we set out to enrich lives all over the world with products meant to inspire creativity, enable makers, and encourage learning. We believe in putting more effort into making a great product than into advertising. We believe in using the highest quality materials over the cheapest. And most importantly, we believe that customer satisfaction is far more important than profit margins.

feeds.title: Puzzle Pusher
feeds.description: Puzzle Pusher is addicted to Puzzles of all types. He buys and solves puzzles, and also blogs about them. You can also find links on where to buy which puzzle.

feeds.title: Gabriel Fernandes' Puzzle Collection
feeds.description: My favorite hobby and greatest interest is collecting and solving mechanical puzzles. I started my collection in August 2008 with... The Rubik's Cube, what else? I guess that's the puzzle many collectors will say that started their collections as well.
